spatial_index._todo: OQ-MAP-INDEX: both cell sizes are first guesses for Shibi, not measured; they change only speed, never a result (scripts/systems/cover_index.gd, LootField's grid). cover_cell_m: grid cell of the cover-wall index (a cover piece is a few metres; a join query spans its chain's ends). loot_cell_m: grid cell of the ground-loot grid (pickup range 2 m, bot loot seek 45 m).

terrain._todo: OQ-MAP-TERRAIN: off is a first guess, not measured; each casting terrain chunk costs a shadow draw per split on the phone, so a Fold measurement decides it.
terrain._far_todo: OQ-MAP-CULL / OQ-MAP-TERRAIN: far_step_m and far_swap_m are first guesses for Shibi, not measured. far_step_m: the far mesh's grid step (a whole multiple of the height-field resolution that divides chunk_size_m; otherwise no far mesh). far_swap_m: every point of a terrain chunk is drawn at full resolution at least out to this camera distance, like a class range_m (the code adds the chunk's radius and classes.margin_m); 0 = no far mesh. 150 m keeps every test_300 chunk near from the centre and swaps five of nine to far from a corner.

proxy_limits._todo: OQ-MAP-PROXY: placeholder limits on tree counts (MapChunks.proxies), not measured frame cost; a Fold measurement decides them.
proxy_limits._note: Each limit is the larger of the two maps' measured values (alesia_section, test_300; measured at M2P1C stop 3, chunk_size_m 100) times 1.5, rounded up to the next step of 1 below 10, 5 below 100, 50 below 1000.
proxy_limits._visible_note: M2P1C stop 8: limits on the visible-at-a-point counts (MapChunks.visible_proxies: batches whose visibility range covers the point, and the shadow casters among them) from the two standard points (MapChunks.standard_points: the play centre and the ground corner, at eye height). Same rule: the larger of the two maps' measured values (alesia_section 83/36 from both points; test_300 centre 284/136, corner 237/119; measured at M2P1C stop 8, chunk_size_m 100) times 1.5, rounded up to the next step of 1 below 10, 5 below 100, 50 below 1000.

classes._todo: OQ-MAP-CULL: every distance and shadow choice here is a first guess for Shibi (a 1 km map, a 200 m aim ray), not measured; a Fold measurement and play decide them.
classes._note: MapChunks puts each batch in a class: by_type "<source>/<type>" first, then "<source>/<kind>" (a decor type "<kind>_<n>" without its _<n>), then by_source. range_m: every piece of the batch is drawn at least out to this camera distance; 0 = never culled. A batch whose pieces have colliders never ends below sight_floor_m (the code raises it; 0 stays never). margin_m is the end margin, hysteresis with fade disabled. cast_shadows (required) is the batch's shadow and wins over the builders' old settings (cover and ring always on, alesia_structures.json batches.cast_shadows).
classes._shadow_rule: Big cover = a cover type at least 1.8 m tall (taller than a standing soldier): pillar, arch, tall_wall, crate_stack, wreck_truck, wreck_apc; the same split for the ring. Rim decor (arches 9 m, rocks 4 m) is big but stays off: it stands at the map's rim, away from the fights, and never cast before.
classes._clutter_note: M2W1 item 5 (OQ-ART-WORLD placeholders): clutter (data/art_clutter.json) never collides, so no sight floor applies; props end at 70 m, field scatter at 45 m (M2W1 astraB: the patches at 60 m; the foliage shader shrinks them away from 42 to 60 m, so they end softly) (plus the batch radius and margin, as every class), no shadows.
